<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Brittle Star on a Barrel Sponge</title>

  <style>
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html,
    body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, #173c43 0%, #091d25 60%, #050d12 100%);
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    #scene {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
    }

    #scene canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      touch-action: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    #scene canvas:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }

    .caption {
      position: fixed;
      left: 24px;
      bottom: 22px;
      z-index: 2;
      max-width: min(360px, calc(100vw - 48px));
      padding: 14px 17px;
      color: #d9eee7;
      background: rgba(5, 20, 25, 0.58);
      border: 1px solid rgba(174, 225, 213, 0.16);
      border-radius: 12px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .caption h1 {
      margin: 0 0 5px;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .caption p {
      margin: 0;
      color: #9fc7bd;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    #loading {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 5;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      color: #b8d5cc;
      background: #091d25;
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
    }

    #loading.hidden {
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .caption {
        left: 14px;
        bottom: 14px;
        padding: 11px 13px;
      }

      .caption h1 {
        font-size: 15px;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <div id="scene"></div>

  <div class="caption">
    <h1>Brittle Star & Barrel Sponge</h1>
    <p>Drag to orbit · Scroll or pinch to zoom</p>
  </div>

  <div id="loading">Preparing the seabed…</div>

    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const container = document.getElementById("scene");
    const loading = document.getElementById("loading");

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer and scene
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x091c23);
    scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x091c23, 0.035);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      40,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;

    renderer.domElement.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      "Interactive 3D view of a brittle star draped over a barrel sponge"
    );

    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(
      0xb8e3df,
      0x39271b,
      1.65
    );
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff0d2, 3.1);
    keyLight.position.set(4.5, 7, 4);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 4;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -3;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 18;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.0004;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const rimLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x78b9c5, 1.7);
    rimLight.position.set(-4, 3.5, -4);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    const warmFill = new THREE.PointLight(0xd58a50, 0.8, 8, 2);
    warmFill.position.set(1.5, 1.2, 3);
    scene.add(warmFill);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Deterministic random helpers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    function createRandom(seed = 1) {
      let state = seed >>> 0;

      return function random() {
        state += 0x6d2b79f5;
        let value = state;
        value = Math.imul(value ^ (value >>> 15), value | 1);
        value ^= value + Math.imul(value ^ (value >>> 7), value | 61);
        return ((value ^ (value >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
      };
    }

    const random = createRandom(84217);

    function randomBetween(min, max) {
      return min + (max - min) * random();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural textures
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    function createSpongeTextures() {
      const size = 512;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = size;
      canvas.height = size;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const textureRandom = createRandom(9182);

      context.fillStyle = "#c9a56d";
      context.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

      // Broad, uneven coloration.
      for (let i = 0; i < 95; i++) {
        const x = textureRandom() * size;
        const y = textureRandom() * size;
        const radius = 20 + textureRandom() * 95;
        const gradient = context.createRadialGradient(
          x, y, 0,
          x, y, radius
        );

        const light = textureRandom() > 0.5;
        gradient.addColorStop(
          0,
          light ? "rgba(255,226,178,0.12)" : "rgba(91,61,31,0.09)"
        );
        gradient.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

        context.fillStyle = gradient;
        context.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
      }

      // Pores and small openings.
      for (let i = 0; i < 1800; i++) {
        const x = textureRandom() * size;
        const y = textureRandom() * size;
        const radius = 0.6 + textureRandom() * 4.2;
        const darkness = 0.08 + textureRandom() * 0.22;

        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.fillStyle = `rgba(67, 43, 24, ${darkness})`;
        context.fill();

        // Tiny highlights make the pores read as indentations.
        const highlight = context.createRadialGradient(
          x - radius * 0.25,
          y - radius * 0.2,
          0,
          x, y, radius
        );
        highlight.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,231,188,0.22)");
        highlight.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,231,188,0)");
        context.fillStyle = highlight;
        context.fillRect(
          x - radius,
          y - radius,
          radius * 2,
          radius * 2
        );
      }

      const colorTexture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      colorTexture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      colorTexture.wrapS = colorTexture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      colorTexture.repeat.set(2.6, 2);
      colorTexture.anisotropy = Math.min(
        8,
        renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy()
      );

      const bumpTexture = colorTexture.clone();
      bumpTexture.colorSpace = THREE.NoColorSpace;
      bumpTexture.needsUpdate = true;

      return { colorTexture, bumpTexture };
    }

    function createSandTexture() {
      const size = 512;
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = size;
      canvas.height = size;

      const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
      const textureRandom = createRandom(3309);

      context.fillStyle = "#81775f";
      context.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);

      for (let i = 0; i < 5000; i++) {
        const x = textureRandom() * size;
        const y = textureRandom() * size;
        const radius = 0.3 + textureRandom() * 2.2;
        const lightness = textureRandom() > 0.5;

        context.beginPath();
        context.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        context.fillStyle = lightness
          ? `rgba(224,211,177,${0.08 + textureRandom() * 0.22})`
          : `rgba(48,42,34,${0.08 + textureRandom() * 0.2})`;
        context.fill();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.repeat.set(13, 13);
      texture.anisotropy = Math.min(
        8,
        renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy()
      );

      return texture;
    }

    const spongeTextures = createSpongeTextures();
    const sandTexture = createSandTexture();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Seabed
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x9a8b70,
      map: sandTexture,
      roughness: 1,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 30),
      groundMaterial
    );
    ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    ground.position.y = -0.035;
    ground.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(ground);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Barrel sponge
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const spongeProfile = [
      new THREE.Vector2(0.0, 0.02),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.02, 0.02),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.36, 0.09),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.52, 0.29),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.58, 0.56),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.57, 0.86),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.49, 1.12),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.34, 1.34),
      new THREE.Vector2(1.08, 1.51),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.72, 1.61),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.34, 1.67),
      new THREE.Vector2(0.0, 1.69)
    ];

    const spongeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xd8b67e,
      map: spongeTextures.colorTexture,
      bumpMap: spongeTextures.bumpTexture,
      bumpScale: 0.055,
      roughness: 0.94,
      metalness: 0
    });

    const sponge = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.LatheGeometry(spongeProfile, 80),
      spongeMaterial
    );
    sponge.castShadow = true;
    sponge.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(sponge);

    // Raised circular rim around the opening.
    const rim = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.94, 0.105, 14, 80),
      spongeMaterial
    );
    rim.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    rim.position.y = 1.57;
    rim.castShadow = true;
    rim.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(rim);

    // A few natural irregularities around the sponge body.
    const noduleGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.1, 12, 8);
    const noduleMaterial = spongeMaterial.clone();
    noduleMaterial.roughness = 1;

    for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
      const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = 0.75 + random() * 0.75;
      const y = 0.18 + random() * 1.42;

      const nodule = new THREE.Mesh(noduleGeometry, noduleMaterial);
      nodule.position.set(
        Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        y,
        Math.sin(angle) * radius
      );
      nodule.scale.set(
        0.7 + random() * 1.1,
        0.35 + random() * 0.5,
        0.7 + random() * 1.1
      );
      nodule.rotation.set(random(), random(), random());
      nodule.castShadow = true;
      nodule.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(nodule);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Brittle star
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const brittleStar = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(brittleStar);

    const discMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x765068,
      roughness: 0.72,
      metalness: 0.02
    });

    const armMaterials = [
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x79516a,
        roughness: 0.76
      }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x65475f,
        roughness: 0.8
      }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x866075,
        roughness: 0.74
      }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x6d4b61,
        roughness: 0.8
      }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x78566d,
        roughness: 0.76
      })
    ];

    const jointGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 12, 8);
    const suckerMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x382536,
      roughness: 0.85
    });

    const centralDisc = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.43, 32, 18),
      discMaterial
    );
    centralDisc.scale.set(1, 0.38, 1);
    centralDisc.position.y = 1.705;
    centralDisc.castShadow = true;
    centralDisc.receiveShadow = true;
    brittleStar.add(centralDisc);

    // Small bumps give the central disc a textured, organic surface.
    const bumpGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 10, 7);

    for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
      const angle = (i / 22) * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = 0.12 + (i % 5) * 0.07;

      const bump = new THREE.Mesh(bumpGeometry, discMaterial);
      bump.position.set(
        Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        1.84 + (i % 3) * 0.012,
        Math.sin(angle) * radius
      );
      bump.scale.setScalar(0.018 + (i % 4) * 0.006);
      brittleStar.add(bump);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Articulated, tapered arms
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    function createArm(angle, length, bend, phase) {
      const points = [];
      const radial = new THREE.Vector3(
        Math.cos(angle),
        0,
        Math.sin(angle)
      );
      const tangent = new THREE.Vector3(
        -Math.sin(angle),
        0,
        Math.cos(angle)
      );

      const segmentCount = 9;

      for (let i = 0; i < segmentCount; i++) {
        const t = i / (segmentCount - 1);

        let radius = 0.22 + length * t;
        let y =
          1.705 +
          0.29 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t) -
          1.55 * t * t +
          0.07 * Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 2 + phase);

        // Small lateral flex makes each arm less mechanical.
        const flex =
          Math.sin(i * 1.37 + phase) * 0.035 * (1 - t * 0.4);

        points.push(new THREE.Vector3(
          radial.x * radius + tangent.x * flex,
          y,
          radial.z * radius + tangent.z * flex
        ));
      }

      const upward = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

      function radiusAt(t) {
        return THREE.MathUtils.lerp(0.058, 0.022, Math.pow(t, 0.72));
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
        const t0 = i / (points.length - 1);
        const t1 = (i + 1) / (points.length - 1);

        const start = points[i];
        const end = points[i + 1];
        const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
        const length = direction.length();

        const segment = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
            radiusAt(t1),
            radiusAt(t0),
            length,
            10,
            1,
            false
          ),
          armMaterials[i % armMaterials.length]
        );

        segment.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
        segment.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
          upward,
          direction.clone().normalize()
        );
        segment.castShadow = true;
        segment.receiveShadow = true;
        brittleStar.add(segment);
      }

      // Visible spheres emphasize the jointed structure.
      for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
        const point = points[i];
        const jointRadius = radiusAt(i / (points.length - 1));

        const joint = new THREE.Mesh(
          jointGeometry,
          armMaterials[(i - 1) % armMaterials.length]
        );
        joint.position.copy(point);
        joint.scale.set(
          jointRadius * 1.08,
          jointRadius * 0.9,
          jointRadius * 1.08
        );
        joint.castShadow = true;
        brittleStar.add(joint);

        // A few small suckers along the underside of the joints.
        if (i % 2 === 0 && i < points.length - 2) {
          const sucker = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.022, 8, 6),
            suckerMaterial
          );
          sucker.position.copy(point);
          sucker.position.addScaledVector(radial, 0.025);
          sucker.position.y -= jointRadius * 0.58;
          sucker.scale.y = 0.55;
          brittleStar.add(sucker);
        }
      }
    }

    // Five arms radiate in different directions and drape down
    // the sponge in slightly different ways.
    createArm(-0.55, 1.24,  0.72, 0.2);
    createArm( 0.72, 1.38, -0.95, 1.4);
    createArm( 2.05, 1.18,  1.05, 2.6);
    createArm( 3.35, 1.32, -0.65, 3.8);
    createArm( 4.75, 1.20,  0.85, 5.1);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Small seabed rocks and marine snow
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const rockGeometry = new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(1, 0);
    const rockMaterials = [
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x777267,
        roughness: 1,
        flatShading: true
      }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x686157,
        roughness: 1,
        flatShading: true
      }),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x918776,
        roughness: 1,
        flatShading: true
      })
    ];

    for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
      const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = 2.0 + random() * 4.5;
      const size = 0.04 + random() * 0.16;

      const rock = new THREE.Mesh(
        rockGeometry,
        rockMaterials[i % rockMaterials.length]
      );

      rock.position.set(
        Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        size * 0.35,
        Math.sin(angle) * radius
      );
      rock.scale.set(
        size * randomBetween(0.8, 1.5),
        size * randomBetween(0.45, 0.9),
        size * randomBetween(0.8, 1.4)
      );
      rock.rotation.set(
        random() * Math.PI,
        random() * Math.PI,
        random() * Math.PI
      );
      rock.castShadow = true;
      rock.receiveShadow = true;
      scene.add(rock);
    }

    const particleCount = 260;
    const particlePositions = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);
    const particleRandom = createRandom(721);

    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
      particlePositions[i * 3] = (particleRandom() - 0.5) * 12;
      particlePositions[i * 3 + 1] = particleRandom() * 4.5;
      particlePositions[i * 3 + 2] = (particleRandom() - 0.5) * 12;
    }

    const particleGeometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    particleGeometry.setAttribute(
      "position",
      new THREE.BufferAttribute(particlePositions, 3)
    );

    const marineSnow = new THREE.Points(
      particleGeometry,
      new THREE.PointsMaterial({
        color: 0xc6d9cf,
        size: 0.025,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.38,
        depthWrite: false,
        sizeAttenuation: true
      })
    );
    scene.add(marineSnow);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Custom camera controls — no external controls addon
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.05, 0);
    let theta = 0.72;
    let phi = 1.13;
    let radius = 7.25;

    function updateCamera() {
      const sinPhi = Math.sin(phi);

      camera.position.set(
        target.x + radius * sinPhi * Math.sin(theta),
        target.y + radius * Math.cos(phi),
        target.z + radius * sinPhi * Math.cos(theta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(target);
    }

    updateCamera();

    const pointers = new Map();
    let lastPointer = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    let previousPinchDistance = 0;

    const canvas = renderer.domElement;

    function pinchDistance() {
      const values = [...pointers.values()];
      if (values.length < 2) return 0;

      return Math.hypot(
        values[0].x - values[1].x,
        values[0].y - values[1].y
      );
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        lastPointer = {
          x: event.clientX,
          y: event.clientY
        };
      } else if (pointers.size === 2) {
        previousPinchDistance = pinchDistance();
      }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (!pointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;

      pointers.set(event.pointerId, {
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        const deltaX = event.clientX - lastPointer.x;
        const deltaY = event.clientY - lastPointer.y;

        theta -= deltaX * 0.006;
        phi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          phi - deltaY * 0.005,
          0.32,
          1.48
        );

        lastPointer = {
          x: event.clientX,
          y: event.clientY
        };
      } else if (pointers.size === 2) {
        const distance = pinchDistance();

        if (previousPinchDistance > 0 && distance > 0) {
          radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            radius * (previousPinchDistance / distance),
            4.1,
            12
          );
        }

        previousPinchDistance = distance;
      }

      updateCamera();
    });

    function releasePointer(event) {
      pointers.delete(event.pointerId);

      if (pointers.size === 1) {
        const remaining = [...pointers.values()][0];
        lastPointer = { x: remaining.x, y: remaining.y };
      }

      previousPinchDistance = 0;
    }

    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", releasePointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", releasePointer);
    canvas.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", releasePointer);

    canvas.addEventListener(
      "wheel",
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();

        radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          radius + event.deltaY * 0.006,
          4.1,
          12
        );

        updateCamera();
      },
      { passive: false }
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Resize and animation
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();

    renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
      const elapsed = clock.getElapsedTime();

      marineSnow.rotation.y = elapsed * 0.008;
      marineSnow.position.y = Math.sin(elapsed * 0.16) * 0.035;

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    });

    loading.classList.add("hidden");
    setTimeout(() => loading.remove(), 500);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
